params.body:
More follow-ups for members.

- **Reading room heading:** the greeting is now the page title ("Welcome back, Shane.", in the section-title size), and the posts follow it directly. Before, "The reading" stacked a second display heading under a smaller greeting, and the two competed. The top "All posts" link goes too: "More posts" under the cards already leads there.
- **Report band:** a member whose plan opens the report sees **Read the report**, not "Read the preview". This uses the same `isDeliverableTo` check as the report page.
- **AI tools page:** a member sees **Your plan and keys** instead of "See what each plan opens". "Create a free account" was already guest-only.

Tests: 355 passing, one new test for the band label.
params.title: Members: one heading in the reading room, Read the report when the plan opens it
